title: 第一卷 第23章 有人针对我第一卷 第24章 飞针
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: 噗呲！
陈久良听完弟子的描述，彻底按了下去，顿时弟子血肉模糊，没了声息！
“该死！真该死！......是谁竟敢杀我侄儿？！”他咆哮片刻，手掌一番，一道血光浮现。
“血炼秘术！显！”
陈久良低吼一声，一道血色光线自其体内激射而出，血色光线流转一圈，随即发生颤动，缓缓指着一个方向。
可很快，血色流光似乎受到了干扰，不停左右摇摆，陈久良顿时露出惊疑不定的神情。
“怎么回事？血炼秘术找不到？难道陈邪得罪了哪位筑基老祖？”
“不！不可能！”陈久良摇摇头。
就算陈邪再傻，也不可能去得罪筑基老祖。
很快他的冷汗直冒！
想到了另一可能！
“难道说，有人在针对我？”陈久良沉思片刻，幽幽道。
血炼秘术没有效果的原因只有两个。
其一，中术者超过施术者一位阶，秘术无效。
其二，对方同样是血炼门的人，对方也施术影响了效果。
若是第一个，其实对他来说还可以接受。
可若是第二个，说明已经有人看出来他要筑基了，并斩断了他的一张底牌。
那麻烦可就大了！
“此事不能声张，血炼门中想看我笑话的人不少，可到底是谁在针对我呢？”
陈久良闭上双眼，脑海中一个个人影浮现，实在是多到难以确定，最终不得不放弃。
那现在就更不能再等了。
虽然他只有炼气十一层，但也能尝试筑基。
他手中底牌不少，还有筑基丹在，成功的概率不算小。
只是可惜了陈邪，他培育了这么多年的种子，只要对方到了炼气后期，他的筑基概率就将大增。
“来人！开启忘忧谷大阵，开启血魄大阵，本座要闭关！”
“还有，去查一查陈邪是怎么死的！老子迟早让那人付出代价！”最后一句话，陈久良几乎是咬着牙崩出。
这个事情没完，阻道之仇不共戴天！
一个半月后。
地下室。
林寻打量着台面上绘制的符箓。
“两百张符纸用完，现在有十张精品火球符，十张回春符，六十张火球符，十张护盾符，十张轻身符！收获满满！”
这么长时间，他除了修炼之外就是画符，挖地洞。
半个月前，已经在下方挖出了三个房间。
实现了既定的目标，下面既有通风，还有防护，安全感倍增。
当然，最让他惊喜的却不是这些。
而是体内的那个红色印记。
林寻内视己身，那个红色印记已消散许多：“不出半年，就能完全磨除。
当然这主要归功于我的特殊体质！”
说到这里，他忍不住自嘲一声，在入仙宗最开始的那段时间，诸多长老看在柳清寒的面子，对他进行全方面的检查。
content_en:
Phew!
After listening to the disciple's description, Chen Jiuliang pressed the button completely. Suddenly, the disciple's flesh and blood became bloody and there was no sound!
"Damn it! Damn it!... Who dares to kill my nephew?!" He roared for a moment, and with a move of his palm, a streak of blood appeared.
"The secret art of blood refining! Show it!"
Chen Jiuliang roared, and a bloody light shot out from his body. The bloody light circulated in a circle, then trembled, and slowly pointed in one direction.
But soon, the bloody stream of light seemed to be disturbed and kept swaying from side to side. Chen Jiuliang suddenly showed a look of uncertainty.
"What's going on? I can't find the secret technique of blood refining? Did Chen Xie offend any foundation-building ancestor?"
"No! Impossible!" Chen Jiuliang shook his head.
No matter how stupid Chen Xie is, he can't offend the foundation-building ancestor.
Soon he was breaking out in cold sweat!
Another possibility comes to mind!
"Could it be that someone is targeting me?" Chen Jiuliang pondered for a moment and said quietly.
There are only two reasons why the blood refining secret technique is ineffective.
First, if the person who performs the magic is one level higher than the one who performs the magic, the secret technique will be ineffective.
Secondly, the other party is also a member of the Blood Refining Sect, and the other party also casts a spell that affects the effect.
If it was the first one, it would actually be acceptable to him.
But if it was the second one, it meant that someone had already seen that he was going to build a foundation and cut off one of his trump cards.
That would be big trouble!
"This matter cannot be made public. There are many people in the Blood Refining Sect who want to see my joke, but who is targeting me?"
Chen Jiuliang closed his eyes, and individual figures appeared in his mind. There were so many that it was difficult to identify them, and he had to give up in the end.
Then we can't wait any longer now.
Although he only has the eleventh level of Qi Refining, he can still try to build a foundation.
He has a lot of trump cards in his hand, and he also has the Foundation Establishment Pill, so the probability of success is not small.
It's just a pity for Chen Xie. He has cultivated the seeds for so many years. As long as the opponent reaches the late stage of Qi refining, his probability of foundation building will greatly increase.
"Come here! Activate the Forgetting Valley Formation, activate the Blood Formation, I am going into seclusion!"
"Yes!"
"Also, go find out how Chen Xie died! I will make that man pay the price sooner or later!" Chen Jiuliang almost gritted his teeth and said the last sentence.
This matter is not over yet, and the hatred of those who block the way is irreconcilable!
...
A month and a half later.
basement.
Lin Xun looked at the talismans drawn on the table.
"Two hundred talismans have been used up, and now there are ten high-quality fireball talismans, ten rejuvenation talismans, sixty fireball talismans, ten shield talismans, and ten light body talismans! Full harvest!"
For such a long time, besides practicing, he only drew talismans and dug holes in the ground.
Half a month ago, three rooms had been dug out below.
The set goal has been achieved. There is both ventilation and protection below, which doubles the sense of security.
Of course, what surprised him the most was not these.
But the red mark inside the body.
Lin Xun looked inside and saw that the red mark had dissipated a lot: "It will be completely erased in less than half a year.
Of course this is mainly due to my special physique! "
Speaking of this, he couldn't help but laugh at himself. During the initial period of joining the Immortal Sect, many elders looked at Liu Qinghan's face and conducted comprehensive inspections on him.
